test_title: PYST 107: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having colours - Red, Blue, Pink, Green, white and black.

Find the colour on the face opposite to the face showing 'Green'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f4db4dd4f7c42c89167297e71c3e22fd059cddfd2212d416b6db6b5f1424222.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70b9eb70d788c5e4dcd804d8b719629c6c7bc569bc6f7468d0cfa73bbc89b2ce.png] 

Here, White and Red are common in both the dice.

So, **'Blue' **is the face opposite to **'Green'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Blue".**
